notes: Tuition: the pages give no fee specific to this BUT. The 2 902 EUR/year differentiated fee applies to non-EU Moroccan students enrolling for the first time in a Licence at a public institution; some institutions exempt foreign students, and the fee may not be confirmed for this specific programme. Source pages describe very different applicant routes: the Parcoursup sheet says foreign non-EU applicants from a Campus France country must not register on Parcoursup, while the Campus France pages address Etudes en France procedures; the application channel is set separately per the task.

Sauf cas de dispense, la certification de français (TCF, DELF B2, DALF) est obligatoire dans le cadre de la procédure de candidature sur la plateforme Études en France.

note.fr: Vérifier le niveau d'anglais et d'espagnol attendu (LV1/LV2) ainsi que les prérequis précis de la formation.
note.en: Check the expected level in English and Spanish (LV1/LV2) and the precise programme prerequisites.
